description: Which indicator types a check can compare, and with which kind of entity (EPOCH-581, replacing the indicator field map of EPOCH-521). Indicators are compared with the entities the entities stage read from the evidence's records by the declared rules in entity_rules.json, never with raw columns, so facts and indicators meet in one normalized form (R2). Each STIX object path names an indicator type; each type is compared with one entity kind, or is listed under no_source with the reason no kind covers it, so a check says what it couldn't compare rather than report no match.

no_source.file_hash: File hashes are in the evidence manifest, which is not a fact (EPOCH-523).
no_source.file_path: File paths are in the decrypt's Manifest.db, which is not a fact (EPOCH-523).
no_source.file_name: File names are in the decrypt's Manifest.db, which is not a fact (EPOCH-523).
no_source.app_certificate: App signing certificates are Android indicators; an iOS backup holds none.
no_source.android_property: Android system properties; an iOS backup holds none.
no_source.configuration_profile: The pinned iLEAPP has no plugin that lists installed configuration profiles.
